Token Usage

Real-time token, context, cost & health analytics for Antigravity — 100% local, zero dependencies, privacy-first.

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

--- ## ⚡ Quick Install (Recommended: One Sentence to Your Agent) You don't need to open a terminal, clone repositories, or copy files manually. **Just paste the sentence below directly into Antigravity Chat**, and let the Agent install and verify everything for you: > ```text > Install the Antigravity plugin from https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage (run sync.sh if available), verify the installed files, and give me the link to enable and open the Token Usage panel. > ``` **What the Agent will do automatically:** 1. Clone `https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage` to a local folder. 2. Sync the plugin bundle (`plugin.json`, `assets/`, `sidecars/`, `skills/`) into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage`. 3. Verify the installation and provide a direct link to Antigravity's **Customizations / Plugins** page so you can toggle **Token Usage** on with one click. ### 🔄 Updating in One Sentence When a new version is released, simply tell Antigravity: > ```text > Update my token-usage plugin from https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage to the latest version and sync it to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage. > ```
🛠️ Prefer Manual Installation (CLI)? Click to expand #### Prerequisites - **Antigravity** installed - **Node.js 18+** (runs the zero-dependency Sidecar web panel) - **Python 3.8+** (runs the Chat Skill / CLI stats script) #### macOS / Linux (Recommended with `sync.sh`) ```bash git clone https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage.git cd token-usage ./sync.sh ``` Or clone directly into the Antigravity plugins directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage ``` #### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\token-usage" ``` #### Enable the Plugin 1. Open **Antigravity** → **Customizations / Plugins**. 2. Enable **Token Usage** (takes effect immediately, no restart needed). 3. Open the **Token Usage** auxiliary side panel (**Aux Pane**) in the sidebar.
--- ## 📖 How to Use Token Usage works in **three ways** — choose whichever fits your workflow best. ### 1. Live Sidecar Panel (Aux Pane) Open the **Token Usage** panel in Antigravity's auxiliary sidebar for real-time visual analytics. #### 📊 Current Tab — Live Session Inspector - **Context Window Gauge**: Live view of used / remaining / limit tokens, cumulative `input`, `cache_read`, and `output` tokens, estimated API-equivalent cost, and cache savings. - **Context Growth Curve**: Tracks context expansion turn-by-turn and automatically highlights **Compact** compression points. - **Realtime Health Diagnostics**: Automatic, dismissible alerts for: - Near-Compact context (`≥80%` warning / `≥90%` critical) - Consecutive error-burn loops - Single-turn token spikes - Low prompt-cache hit rates - **100% Local Lite DLP Secret Detection**: Scans local transcripts for 7 high-confidence credential patterns (`API Keys`, `AWS Keys`, `GitHub Tokens`, `Google Keys`, `JWT`, `Private Keys`, `DB URIs`). Raw secrets are **never stored or displayed** — only masked snippets with a one-click jump to the exact turn. - **Per-Turn Breakdown & JSON Tree Viewer**: - Splits every turn into **Model Thinking time vs. Tool Execution time**, with model and tool attribution. - Supports keyword search and quick filters (`All` / `High` / `Errors` / `Media`). - Expand any tool call with the built-in searchable, collapsible **JSON Tree Viewer**. - **Desensitized Session Diagnostic Card (PNG)**: Export or copy a 2× HiDPI diagnostic snapshot (context curve, tokens, cache rate, model/tool stats) — **100% anonymized with zero prompts, file paths, project names, or secrets**. #### 📈 Overview Tab — 12+ Global & Trend Analytics - **Subscription ROI Dashboard**: Click the subscription card to configure your plan (`$20 Pro` / `$100 Ultra` / `$200 Ultra` or any custom price, monthly/weekly cycle, and billing reset day). Track your ROI multiplier, end-of-month forecast, and total cache savings. - **Activity & Coding Persona**: 90-day GitHub-style heatmap, 14-day daily bar chart, 24-hour coding persona & weekday/weekend split, global Top 10 models & tools, context health score, local achievements, and Hall of Fame. - **Project Attribution**: Automatically infers your Top 10 active workspaces from tool file paths. - **Local Multi-Tool Radar**: Lightweight, read-only local detection of session counts across **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Cursor**, and **Gemini CLI**. - **Retina Overview Report Card (PNG)**: Generate a customizable 2× HiDPI share card (Dark & Light themes, toggleable modules) and copy directly to your clipboard or save to `~/Downloads`. #### 🕒 History Tab & Toolbar Actions - **History Tab**: Browse and jump into any past Antigravity conversation. - **Language Toggle (`EN / 中`)**: Switch the panel UI between English and Chinese in one click. - **Settings Modal**: - Switch currency between `USD ($)` and `CNY (¥)` with an editable exchange rate. - Customize per-1M-token pricing for `Pro`, `Flash`, `Claude`, and `GPT/Codex` model families. - Check for plugin updates via GitHub Releases. - **Export Modal**: - Export filtered billing ledgers (`This Month` / `Last 30 Days` / `All Time`) as UTF-8 BOM **CSV** or **JSON**. - Export the current session as Markdown or a desensitized summary directly to `~/Downloads`. --- ### 2. In-Chat Skill (`/token-usage` or Natural Language) Once enabled, Antigravity automatically loads the bundled `token-usage` Skill. You can type `/token-usage` or simply ask in plain language: - *"Summarize token usage for my last 10 sessions"* - *"Show per-turn token breakdown for the current session"* - *"Aggregate total token consumption by model"* - *"Which 5 sessions consumed the most tokens?"* --- ### 3. Standalone CLI Script (`token_stats.py`) You can also query your local transcripts directly from any terminal (Python 3 standard library only): ```bash # 1. Summary across recent sessions (--sort: recent | tokens, --limit: default 15) python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/skills/token-usage/scripts/token_stats.py summary --limit 15 --sort recent # 2. Per-turn breakdown for a single session (pass "latest", an 8-char ID prefix, or full UUID) python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/skills/token-usage/scripts/token_stats.py session latest # 3. Global & per-model token totals python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/skills/token-usage/scripts/token_stats.py models ``` > **Token Definitions**: `input` = uncached prompt input tokens, `cache_read` = prompt-cache hit tokens, `output` = model-generated tokens (`total = input + output`, excluding cache reads unless specified). --- ## 🔒 Privacy & Security - **100% Local & Read-Only**: Reads local Antigravity transcripts (`~/.gemini/antigravity/brain//.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`) directly on your machine. Never modifies Antigravity binaries or uploads conversation data. - **Zero External Dependencies**: Built strictly with Node.js ESM built-ins, vanilla HTML/CSS/Canvas/JS, and the Python standard library. - **Privacy-Safe Sharing**: Session diagnostic PNGs strip all user prompts, file paths, workspace names, and detected credentials. - **Network Transparency**: Zero telemetry or analytics. The optional *Check for Updates* action only queries GitHub's public Releases API (cached locally for 7 days). --- ## ❓ FAQ & Troubleshooting
The Token Usage side panel doesn't appear after installation 1. Verify the plugin files exist in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/plugin.json`. 2. Open Antigravity → **Customizations / Plugins** and confirm **Token Usage** is enabled. 3. Make sure `node` (Node.js 18+) is available in your system `PATH` so the Sidecar server can start.
Why do estimated costs differ from my subscription or API bill? Costs shown in the panel are API-equivalent estimates based on default per-1M-token rates for each model family (`Pro`, `Flash`, `Claude`, `GPT/Codex`). You can customize every model family's unit price, currency (`USD`/`CNY`), and your subscription plan/cycle anytime in the **Settings** modal.
How do I uninstall Token Usage? You can ask Antigravity in one sentence (*"Uninstall the token-usage plugin"*), disable/uninstall it from **Customizations / Plugins**, or manually delete `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage`.
--- ## 📚 Architecture & Links - [Project Architecture Map (`.ai_map.md`)](./.ai_map.md) - [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage) - [Discussions & Roadmap](https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage/discussions)

Token Usage

面向 Antigravity 的实时 Token、上下文水位、成本估算与会话健康度分析插件 —— 100% 本地只读、零外部依赖、隐私优先。

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

--- ## ⚡ 快速安装（强烈推荐：让 Agent 一句话搞定） 无需打开终端、无需手动 clone 或复制文件。**直接将下面这句话粘贴发送给 Antigravity 对话框**，让 Agent 自动完成克隆、同步、校验并引导你一键开启： > ```text > 请帮我把 https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage 这个 Antigravity 插件安装到 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage（优先运行仓库自带的 sync.sh 同步），检查安装文件是否完整，并给我启用和打开 Token Usage 面板的入口。 > ``` **Agent 会自动为你完成以下步骤：** 1. 拉取 `https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage` 仓库代码。 2. 将核心插件文件（`plugin.json`、`assets/`、`sidecars/`、`skills/`）同步至 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage`。 3. 校验安装完整性，并直接返回 **Customizations / Plugins** 页面链接，点击即可一键启用 **Token Usage**。 ### 🔄 一句话更新到最新版本 后续有新版本发布时，同样只需对 Antigravity 说一句： > ```text > 请帮我把 token-usage 插件从 https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage 更新到最新版本，并重新同步到 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage。 > ```
🛠️ 偏好手动命令行安装？点击展开 #### 环境要求 - 已安装 **Antigravity** - **Node.js 18+**（运行零依赖的 Sidecar 侧边栏面板） - **Python 3.8+**（运行对话 Skill 与命令行统计脚本） #### macOS / Linux（推荐使用 `sync.sh`） ```bash git clone https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage.git cd token-usage ./sync.sh ``` 或直接克隆到 Antigravity 插件目录： ```bash git clone https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage ``` #### Windows (PowerShell) ```powershell git clone https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\token-usage" ``` #### 启用插件 1. 打开 **Antigravity** → **Customizations / Plugins**（自定义/插件管理）。 2. 开启 **Token Usage**（实时生效，无需重启）。 3. 在右侧辅助栏（**Aux Pane**）打开 **Token Usage** 面板即可使用。
--- ## 📖 详细使用指南 Token Usage 提供**三种使用方式**，可按场景自由搭配。 ### 1. 侧边栏实时面板（Sidecar Aux Pane） 在 Antigravity 右侧辅助栏打开 **Token Usage**，即可获得全实时可视化分析体验。 #### 📊 当前会话（Current 面板） - **上下文水位仪表盘**：实时展示已用 / 剩余 / 上限上下文 Token、累计 `input` / `cache_read` / `output` 消耗、等效 API 费用与缓存省钱金额。 - **上下文增长曲线**：逐轮绘制上下文膨胀趋势，自动标红 **Compact 压缩点**。 - **实时会话健康诊断**：自动检测并可手动关闭以下 4 类异常预警： - 临近 Compact 上下文阈值（`≥80%` 警告 / `≥90%` 严重） - 连续报错空转循环 - 单轮 Token 异常激增 - 提示词缓存命中率偏低 - **100% 本地 Lite DLP 敏感凭证扫描**：纯本地扫描 7 类高置信度凭证（`API Key`、`AWS Key`、`GitHub Token`、`Google Key`、`JWT`、私钥、数据库连接串）。**绝不存储或展示明文**，仅显示打码片段，支持一键跳转对应轮次排查。 - **逐轮明细与 JSON 树状查看器**： - 将每一轮拆解为 **模型思考耗时 vs 工具执行耗时**，清晰呈现模型与工具归因。 - 支持关键词搜索与快捷筛选（全部 / 高消耗 / 含错误 / 含媒体）。 - 内置可搜索、可折叠、一键复制的 **JSON 树状查看器**，轻松查看工具入参与返回结果。 - **单会话脱敏诊断图（PNG）**：一键生成 2× 高清诊断卡片（含上下文曲线、Token、缓存率与模型/工具统计），**100% 脱敏，绝不包含提问内容、文件路径、项目名或敏感信息**。 #### 📈 趋势总览（Overview 面板 · 12+ 项看板） - **订阅回本 ROI 仪表盘**：点击订阅卡片即可配置你的套餐（`$20 Pro` / `$100 Ultra` / `$200 Ultra` 或自定义月/周费与重置日），实时计算回本倍数、月末消耗预测与缓存“白嫖”省钱额。 - **活跃与作息画像**：90 天 GitHub 风格活跃热力图、近 14 天每日柱状图、24 小时编码作息人格与工作日/周末对比、全机模型与工具 Top 10、上下文健康度评分、本地成就徽章墙与名人堂。 - **项目成本归因**：根据工具操作路径自动推断活跃工作区 Top 10 及其消耗占比。 - **本地多工具雷达（Multi-Tool Radar）**：轻量只读探测本机 **Claude Code**、**Codex**、**Cursor**、**Gemini CLI** 的历史会话数。 - **2× 视网膜级战报分享图（PNG）**：支持深色/浅色双主题与模块开关自定义，一键复制图片到剪贴板或保存到 `~/Downloads`。 #### 🕒 历史记录与顶部工具栏 - **历史面板（History）**：快速检索并切换查看任意历史会话。 - **双语切换（`EN / 中`）**：一键切换面板中英文界面。 - **设置弹窗**： - 切换币种 `USD ($)` / `CNY (¥)` 并自定义汇率。 - 自定义 `Pro`、`Flash`、`Claude`、`GPT/Codex` 各模型家族的百万 Token 单价。 - 支持通过 GitHub Releases 一键检查插件更新。 - **导出弹窗**： - 按「本月 / 近 30 天 / 全部」一键导出 UTF-8 BOM **CSV** 或 **JSON** 账单明细。 - 导出当前会话的 Markdown 报告或脱敏诊断摘要，直接保存至 `~/Downloads`。 --- ### 2. 对话内 Skill 调用（`/token-usage` 或自然语言） 启用插件后，Antigravity 会自动加载内置的 `token-usage` Skill。你可以输入 `/token-usage`，或者直接在对话框用自然语言提问： - “统计最近 10 个会话的 Token 消耗汇总” - “查看当前会话每一轮对话的 Token 明细” - “按模型统计我所有会话的 Token 总消耗” - “找出消耗 Token 最多的前 5 个会话” --- ### 3. 独立命令行脚本（`token_stats.py`） 你也可以在任意终端直接运行内置统计脚本（仅依赖 Python 3 标准库）： ```bash # 1. 查看近期会话汇总（--sort 支持 recent | tokens，--limit 默认 15） python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/skills/token-usage/scripts/token_stats.py summary --limit 15 --sort recent # 2. 查看单会话逐轮明细（支持传入 latest、8 位 ID 前缀或完整 UUID） python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/skills/token-usage/scripts/token_stats.py session latest # 3. 查看全机及各模型 Token 总消耗 python3 ~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/skills/token-usage/scripts/token_stats.py models ``` > **字段说明**：`input` 为未命中缓存的输入 Token，`cache_read` 为提示词缓存命中 Token，`output` 为模型输出 Token（默认 `total = input + output`，除非显式要求合并缓存读取）。 --- ## 🔒 隐私与安全 - **100% 本地只读**：直接读取本机 Antigravity 会话日志（`~/.gemini/antigravity/brain//.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`），不修改官方程序、不上传任何对话或代码。 - **零外部依赖**：纯原生 Node.js (ESM) + 原生前端 + Python 标准库实现，无任何第三方 npm/pip 依赖包。 - **分享级隐私保护**：单会话诊断 PNG 自动剥离所有用户输入、文件路径、项目名称及检测到的敏感凭证。 - **网络透明度**：零埋点、零遥测上报；仅在手动或静默检查版本更新时请求 GitHub Releases 公开接口（结果本地缓存 7 天）。 --- ## ❓ 常见问题排查
安装完成后没有看到 Token Usage 侧边栏面板？ 1. 确认 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/plugin.json` 文件存在。 2. 打开 Antigravity → **Customizations / Plugins**，确认 **Token Usage** 处于启用状态。 3. 确认系统 `PATH` 中可以正常调用 `node`（Node.js 18+），以便 Sidecar 本地服务启动。
面板估算的费用为什么和官方账单有差异？ 面板费用基于各模型家族（`Pro`、`Flash`、`Claude`、`GPT/Codex`）的默认百万 Token 单价进行 API 等效估算。你可以随时在右上角 **设置** 弹窗中修改单价、汇率（`USD`/`CNY`）以及你的实际订阅费用与周期。
如何卸载 Token Usage？ 你可以直接对 Antigravity 说一句（*“帮我卸载 token-usage 插件”*），也可以在 **Customizations / Plugins** 中关闭/卸载，或手动删除 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage` 目录。
--- ## 📚 项目文档与链接 - [项目架构导航（`.ai_map.md`）](./.ai_map.md) - [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage) - [讨论区与路线图](https://github.com/RanFeng/token-usage/discussions)

Never modifies Antigravity binaries or uploads conversation data. - **Zero External Dependencies**: Built strictly with Node.js ESM built-ins, vanilla HTML/CSS/Canvas/JS, and the Python standard library. - **Privacy-Safe Sharing**: Session diagnostic PNGs strip all user prompts, file paths, workspace names, and detected credentials. - **Network Transparency**: Zero telemetry or analytics. The optional *Check for Updates* action only queries GitHub's public Releases API (cached locally for 7 days). --- ## ❓ FAQ & Troubleshooting
The Token Usage side panel doesn't appear after installation 1. Verify the plugin files exist in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage/plugin.json`. 2. Open Antigravity → **Customizations / Plugins** and confirm **Token Usage** is enabled. 3. Make sure `node` (Node.js 18+) is available in your system `PATH` so the Sidecar server can start.
Why do estimated costs differ from my subscription or API bill? Costs shown in the panel are API-equivalent estimates based on default per-1M-token rates for each model family (`Pro`, `Flash`, `Claude`, `GPT/Codex`). You can customize every model family's unit price, currency (`USD`/`CNY`), and your subscription plan/cycle anytime in the **Settings** modal.
How do I uninstall Token Usage? You can ask Antigravity in one sentence (*"Uninstall the token-usage plugin"*), disable/uninstall it from **Customizations / Plugins**, or manually delete `~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-usage`.
